DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。防犯用品のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you here to ask about personal safety products?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このブザーの使い方を知りたいです。鳴るか試したいのですが、ここで突然鳴らす前に方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ブザー未作動で突然試す前に方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to know how to use this alarm. I want to test whether it sounds, but I'd like to ask how before setting it off suddenly here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to test the alarm before suddenly setting it off; you have not activated it yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ作動させていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't activated it yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。引く部分は見つけましたが、止め方が分からないので、そのまま引いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引く部分は分かるが止め方不明でまだ引いていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I found the part to pull, but I don't know how to stop it, so I haven't pulled it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found the part to pull but have not pulled it because you do not know how to stop the alarm. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず止め方も含めて担当が説明します。試す場合は、案内された場所で行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, the person in charge will explain, including how to stop it. If you test it, please do so in the place you are shown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから試します。音だけでなく、引いた部分を戻す手順も自分で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開始停止説明後に戻す手順も自分で確認したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll listen to the explanation before testing it. Besides the sound, I'd also like to check for myself how to put the part I pulled back in place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that after the explanation of starting and stopping, you also want to check for yourself how to return the pulled part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周囲へ試験だと知らせ、実際の困り事と混同されないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll let people nearby know it is a test so that they don't confuse it with an actual emergency.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。人の多い待合で勝手に試さず、担当の案内に従います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混雑待合で自己試験せず案内場所に従うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't test it on my own in the crowded waiting area; I'll follow the staff member's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not test it yourself in the crowded waiting area and will use the place indicated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明後も分からない所があれば、お尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask if anything is still unclear after the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鳴らし方と止め方の両方を確認します。試し鳴らしは知らせてから、指定の場所で行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開始停止両方を学び試験告知と指定場所で試すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check both how to sound it and how to stop it. I'll announce the test before sounding it in the designated place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will learn both how to start and stop it, announce the test, and try it in the designated place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当の説明をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll arrange for the person in charge to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。差出しでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you mail something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二通の封筒を送りたいです。切手の合計は用意しましたが、一方の封筒に全部貼ってしまったので、差し出す前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二通分切手を片方へまとめ貼付したため差出前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send two envelopes. I prepared enough stamps for the total postage, but I stuck them all on one envelope, so I'd like to ask before mailing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice before mailing because you put the stamps for two envelopes together on just one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二通は別々に送る物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are these two items being sent separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、相手も違います。二通分の合計があればよいと思い、もう一方には貼っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別宛先別封筒で他方未貼付と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, to different people as well. I thought having the total postage for both was enough, so I haven't put any stamps on the other envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that they are separate envelopes for different recipients and that the other has no stamps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの郵便物の料金を分けて確認しましょう。貼付済み切手の扱いもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the postage for each mail item separately. We'll also explain what to do about the stamps already attached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で剥がして破る前に、今の状態で見てもらいます。二通の大きさと中身も同じではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 剥がさず現状態で相談し二通サイズ内容も異なると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll have you look at them as they are, before I try peeling off the stamps and tear them. The envelopes are not the same size, and their contents are different too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will consult with the envelopes as they are without peeling off the stamps and that their sizes and contents differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の二通を拝見します。合計だけでは各料金が足りるか判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me see both envelopes as they are. The total alone doesn't tell us whether each has enough postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。片方に多く貼ったことと、片方が未貼付であることを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 過剰貼付と未貼付を別に説明すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll explain separately that one has too many stamps and the other has none.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will explain the excess stamps and the lack of stamps separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後にそれぞれの差出し方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we'll explain how to mail each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二通を一つの支払い済み郵便と思わず、各封筒の料金と切手の状態を確認してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各封筒料金と切手状態確認後発送すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't treat the two as a single prepaid mail item. I'll check the postage and the stamps on each envelope before mailing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will mail them after checking each envelope's postage and stamp condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まずこちらの封筒から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let's start by checking this envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。説明資料でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the explanatory material?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この資料は月一万円、ボーナス月は追加三万円とあります。ボーナス月は三万円だけだと思いましたが、追加という意味を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 月額一万ボーナス月追加三万で当月三万のみか語義を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This material says 10,000 yen a month and an additional 30,000 yen in bonus months. I thought bonus months meant just 30,000 yen, but I'd like to check what “additional” means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the monthly 10,000 yen plus an additional 30,000 yen in bonus months means only 30,000 yen that month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通常の月額に加える額という記載ですね。どの月を考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It says this amount is added to the regular monthly amount. Which month do you have in mind?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十二月です。私は三万円から一万円を引くと思って、二万円とメモしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十二月を考え追加三万から月額一万を引き二万と誤記したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: December. I thought I should subtract 10,000 yen from 30,000 yen, so I wrote down 20,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mean December and mistakenly wrote 20,000 yen after subtracting the monthly 10,000 yen from the additional 30,000 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この二つの記載だけを足すなら、一万円と三万円で四万円です。実際の請求は契約担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: If we simply add these two listed amounts, 10,000 plus 30,000 is 40,000 yen. Please confirm the actual bill with the staff member handling the contract.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 引く計算ではありませんね。資料上の四万円と、正式な請求額が同じかは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料計算四万と正式請求一致は別確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it isn't subtraction. I'll check separately whether the 40,000 yen calculated from the material matches the official bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will separately confirm whether the 40,000 yen calculation in the material matches the official bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの費用や時期についても、契約内容で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also check other charges and timing in the contract terms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私のメモには二万円の誤計算を残さず、通常分と追加分を別に書きます。家族にも訂正して伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 月額追加額を分け誤計算を訂正し家族へ伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't leave the mistaken 20,000 yen calculation in my notes; I'll write the regular amount and the additional amount separately. I'll correct what I told my family too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate the monthly and additional amounts, correct the calculation, and inform your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その資料と確認したい月を担当へ示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the staff member this material and the month you wish to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十二月の通常一万円、追加三万円という記載を示します。三万円が通常分を置き換えると思わず、請求内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十二月両記載を示し追加を置換とせず契約請求を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the entries for December: the regular 10,000 yen and the additional 30,000 yen. I won't assume the 30,000 yen replaces the regular amount; I'll check the billing details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show both December entries and check the contract billing without treating the additional amount as a replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。契約の説明担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll direct you to the person who explains the contract.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お買い物のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there anything I can help you with while shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の朝の集まりにパンを用意したいです。今日並ぶ焼きたてを今買うか、明日の受取りを相談するか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌朝用パンを今日買うか翌日受取相談するか迷いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to prepare bread for a gathering tomorrow morning. I'm deciding whether to buy today's freshly baked bread now or ask about picking it up tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure whether to buy bread for tomorrow morning today or ask about collecting it tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 明日は何時ごろ使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: What time will you need it tomorrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝八時です。お店が開く時刻より前なので、明日受け取れると決めつけてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用朝八時が開店前で翌日受取可能と決めないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: At eight in the morning. That's before the shop opens, so I'm not assuming I can collect it tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that you will use it at eight in the morning before opening time and are not assuming next-day collection is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取りの時刻と、保管の案内を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the collection time separately from the storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日買う場合は表示の保存方法と期限を見ます。今日の焼きたてだから、明日の朝も同じ状態とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日購入時は保管期限を見て翌朝同状態と仮定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I buy it today, I'll check the storage instructions and the date on the label. I won't assume that being freshly baked today means it will be in the same condition tomorrow morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that if you buy today, you will check storage and date information rather than assume the same condition tomorrow morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な数も教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you also tell me how many you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 六人で一つずつ、予備二つの計八個です。人数六人と注文八個を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 六人各一予備二で八個と人数注文数を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One each for six people and two extra, making eight in total. I'll distinguish the six people from the eight items I'm ordering.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish six people from an order of eight: one each plus two extra. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望に合う受取りの相談を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about collection arrangements that suit your needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 八個を朝八時に使う予定です。受取可能時刻と表示を聞いてから、今日購入するかを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 八時使用八個の受取時刻と表示確認後に購入日を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I plan to use eight at eight in the morning. I'll ask about possible collection times and the label information before deciding whether to buy today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide the purchase day after checking collection times and label information for eight items needed at eight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll pass your request to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園の案内でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help with the park information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遠くで鐘が鳴ったので、閉園かと思いました。友人を急がせる前に、この公園の案内だったか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鐘を閉園と思い仲間を急かす前に案内音か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard a bell in the distance and thought the park was closing. Before I hurry my friends along, I'd like to ask whether that was an announcement for this park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the bell was a park announcement before hurrying your companions because you thought it meant closing time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 放送の言葉も聞こえましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you hear any words in an announcement too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 言葉はなく、鐘だけでした。時計を見ずに、帰る合図だと思ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 放送言葉はなく時計未確認で帰る合図と解釈したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There were no words, just the bell. Without checking the clock, I assumed it was a signal to leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there were no spoken words and you interpreted it as a signal to leave without checking the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の音だけでは、公園の閉園案内とは判断できません。利用時間の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That sound alone doesn't establish that it was a park closing announcement. Please check the posted opening hours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの表示ですね。閉園の時間を見て、今の時刻と比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用時間表示を現時刻と比較すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This sign here, right? I'll look at the closing time and compare it with the current time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will compare the posted hours with the current time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご友人との待合せの予定も確認するとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would also help to confirm the arrangements you made with your friends.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人とはもう少し散歩すると話していました。鐘が閉園だと決まったようなメッセージは送りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: もう少し散歩予定の友人へ閉園確定メッセージを送らないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We had agreed to walk a little longer. I won't send them a message stating as a fact that the bell meant the park was closing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not send your friends, with whom you planned to walk longer, a message treating closing as confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な時刻を確認してから予定を相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the times you need before discussing your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示の時間と今の時刻で余裕を確かめ、友人へ帰る時間を相談します。鐘の意味を推測して急がせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示時刻確認後帰る時刻を相談し鐘の推測で急かさないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check how much time we have using the posted hours and the current time, then discuss when to leave with my friends. I won't hurry them based on a guess about the bell.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the posted and current times, discuss departure, and avoid hurrying others based on a guess about the bell. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。時間に気をつけてお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Enjoy your visit while keeping an eye on the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。乗り場をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you find your boarding point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上りに乗ると聞きました。地図の上が北なので、北へ行く便だと思いましたが、目的地で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上りを北進と解釈したため目的地で乗車方向を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to take the up-bound service. Since north is at the top of the map, I thought that meant a northbound service, but I'd like to check using my destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you interpreted up-bound as northbound and want to confirm the direction using your destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの駅へ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which station are you going to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が案内に書いたこの駅です。地図では南側にあるので、上りという言葉と合わず迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的地は地図南で上りの語との不一致を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This station my friend wrote in the directions. It's south on the map, so I was confused because that didn't seem to match “up-bound.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your destination is south on the map and that this seemed inconsistent with the term up-bound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上り下りを地図の上下だけで決めず、行先と利用便で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the destination and the service you will use rather than deciding up-bound and down-bound from the map's top and bottom alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。上りと聞いたことより、降りたい駅名をまず伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 聞いた上下方向より降車駅名を先に示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll give you the station where I want to get off first, rather than starting with having heard “up-bound.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will first give the name of the station where you will get off rather than the direction you heard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この時刻の便について、行先表示をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you the destination display for the service at this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示に目的地があるか確認します。地図を回転すると上下も変わるので、その向きで乗り場を変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 便行先確認で地図回転の上下変化に乗り場を依存させないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check whether my destination is listed. Rotating the map changes its top and bottom too, so I won't change boarding points based on that orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the service destination and not base the boarding point on the top and bottom of a rotated map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗り場と便の案内も合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the boarding point and service information together too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅名、便の時刻、乗り場を照合します。上りを北と決めた説明は友人にも訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅便乗り場を照合し友人へ上り北解釈を訂正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll cross-check the station name, departure time, and boarding point. I'll also correct my explanation to my friend that up-bound meant north.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will cross-check the station, service time, and boarding point and correct the up-bound-means-north interpretation for your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please look at this information here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談票の記入をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you fill out the consultation form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語の資格欄にＮ二と書きかけました。今勉強している級ですが、合格した資格を書く欄なら、違うので確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本語資格欄の勉強中Ｎ二が合格級と誤認されるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I started writing N2 in the Japanese qualification field. That's the level I'm studying now, but if this field is for qualifications I've passed, that would be incorrect, so I'd like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether writing the N2 you are studying in the Japanese qualification field would wrongly imply you have passed it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受験や合格の状況はどうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What is your examination and passing status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: Ｎ三には合格しました。Ｎ二は次に受ける予定で、まだ受験していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: Ｎ三合格済みでＮ二は次回予定未受験と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've passed N3. I plan to take N2 next, but I haven't taken it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have passed N3 and plan to take N2 next but have not taken it yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取得した資格と、学習中の内容を分けて記載しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's list the qualification you've obtained separately from what you're studying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資格欄はＮ三に直します。Ｎ二を勉強中という情報も、相談のために別に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資格欄Ｎ三へ直しＮ二学習情報は別に伝えたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll correct the qualification field to N3. I'd also like to mention separately that I'm studying N2, for the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will change the qualification field to N3 and want to provide the N2 study information separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 備考に学習状況を書くか、担当へお話しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can write your study status in the remarks or tell the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では備考にＮ二を勉強中、受験予定と書きます。合格予定と保証する表現にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 備考は学習中受験予定で合格保証とは書かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll write in the remarks that I'm studying N2 and plan to take the exam. I won't phrase it as a guarantee that I'll pass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the remarks will state you are studying and plan to take the exam, not guarantee a pass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合格済みの情報は、必要な確認資料も案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also explain any documents needed to verify the qualification you've already passed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: Ｎ三合格とＮ二学習中を分けて提出します。勉強しているだけでＮ二を取得したとは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取得Ｎ三と学習Ｎ二を区別して提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll submit N3 passed and N2 in progress separately. I won't write that I've obtained N2 simply because I'm studying for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the obtained N3 qualification and ongoing N2 studies as distinct information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll check what you've filled in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の面会に来ました。入口で診察の用紙を取ってしまいましたが、今日は私が受診するわけではないので案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 面会なのに診察用紙を取ったため受診受付と分け案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come to visit a friend. I picked up a consultation form at the entrance, but I'm not here to see a doctor myself today, so I'd like some directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for visitor directions separately from patient registration because you took a consultation form despite coming to visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人のいる病棟などは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which ward your friend is in, for example?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人から連絡された病棟名があります。部屋番号を聞いていないので、診察受付で待てばよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 病棟名のみ把握で診察受付待ちと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the ward name they sent me. I didn't ask the room number, so I thought I should wait at the patient reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you know only the ward name and thought you should wait at patient reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 面会の案内を担当へ確認しましょう。用紙は未記入ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the person in charge about visits. Is the form still blank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、名前も書いていません。診察用の紙は戻し、面会の相談として必要な情報を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未記入紙を戻し面会情報として相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I haven't even written my name. I'll return the consultation form and give the information needed for a visit instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will return the blank form and consult using the information for a visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 面会できるかは、現在の案内に沿って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check whether you can visit according to the current guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人が誘ったから必ず今入れるとは思わず、病棟名と面会希望を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人招待で即入場可能とせず現案内を担当へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't assume I can enter right now just because my friend invited me. I'll tell the person in charge the ward name and that I'd like to visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check current visitor guidance with the person in charge rather than assume an invitation means immediate entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内まで、診察の順番に入って待つ必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You don't need to join the queue for a medical consultation while waiting for directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらの指示された場所で待ちます。患者の受付と友人への面会を分けて、用紙も誤って提出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察順番でなく指示待機場所に待ち誤った用紙を提出しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait in the place you've directed me to. I'll distinguish patient registration from visiting my friend and won't submit the wrong form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait at the instructed place rather than in the patient queue and will not submit the wrong form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。面会の担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll direct you to the staff member responsible for visits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。資料のご相談をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you discuss your material?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 出来事の映像を見せたいです。自分で編集した物が左右反転になっているので、現場の左右の説明に使う前にお知らせしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 編集映像が左右反転のため方向説明前に申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to show footage of an incident. The version I edited is mirrored left to right, so I'd like to let you know before using it to explain left and right at the scene.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Disclose that the edited footage is mirrored before explaining directions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 編集前の映像は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have the footage from before editing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。元の映像では看板の文字が普通に読めます。編集後は文字も逆なので、反転したと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元データ保持で文字が逆になった編集版から反転に気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. In the original, the letters on the sign can be read normally. After editing, the letters are reversed too, which is how I noticed it was mirrored.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you kept the original and noticed the mirroring because the letters were reversed in the edited version. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の映像と編集後を区別してお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish the original footage from the edited version when showing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元を見せます。編集後の右側へ動いたという説明は、現場で右へ進んだ意味にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元を示し編集画面右を現場右としないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll show the original. Saying something moved right in the edited version won't mean that it moved right at the actual scene.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will show the original and not equate screen-right in the edited version with right at the scene. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 向きは目印も使って確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's also use landmarks to verify the orientation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口と看板を目印にします。私が撮影した位置も説明し、画面の左右だけで方向を決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口看板撮影位置で方向を説明し画面左右のみで決めないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use the entrance and the sign as landmarks. I'll also explain where I was filming from, rather than decide the direction just from left and right on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain directions using the entrance, sign, and filming position rather than screen left and right alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 編集した内容も、分かる範囲でお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also explain what you edited, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左右反転と短く切ったことを伝えます。元を消さず、編集版の向きで現場を断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 反転と切抜きを申告し元を保持して編集方向を事実としないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain that I mirrored it and cut it shorter. I'll keep the original and won't make definitive claims about the scene using the edited version's orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will disclose the mirroring and trimming, preserve the original, and not treat the edited directions as fact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。元の資料から拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll start by looking at the original material.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help sending something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 箱に天地無用と書きたいです。上下を気にしなくてよいという意味だと思っていましたが、逆かもしれないので教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 天地無用を上下自由と誤解したため語義を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to write “tenchi muyō” on this box. I thought it meant the top and bottom didn't matter, but that may be the opposite, so could you explain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what tenchi muyō means because you mistakenly thought it meant any orientation was acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その言葉は、上下を逆にしないようにという意味です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: That expression means not to turn it upside down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: やはり逆でした。この箱は立てた向きで渡したいので、どちらが上かも分かるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上下逆禁止と理解し箱の上方向も明示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I did have it backward. I'd like to hand over this box upright, so I also want to make it clear which side is the top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you understand it means not to invert the box and want to mark the top clearly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示だけでなく中の梱包も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the packing inside as well as the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中の物が動かないようにしました。言葉を貼っただけで、揺れや破損が必ず防げるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中を固定したが表示だけで無破損保証と思わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've secured the contents so they won't move. I don't think that simply attaching those words guarantees protection from shaking or damage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you secured the contents but do not think the label alone guarantees no damage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上の向きを示す位置と宛名が、分かるようになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is the top indicator and the address clearly visible?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ふたの側を上としました。宛名もその面です。横の表示だけではどの面が上か分かりにくいので直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ふた上と宛名面を示し不明瞭な横表示を直すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've made the lid side the top. The address is on that face too. The marking on the side alone doesn't clearly show which face is the top, so I'll fix it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that the lid and address side is the top and you will correct the unclear side marking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示を整えた状態で受付にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring the box to the counter with the markings in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上下逆にしないという意味で使い、上の面を明確にします。梱包も含めて確認してから差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上面表示と梱包確認後に上下逆禁止の意味で発送すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use the words to mean “do not turn upside down” and clearly mark the top face. I'll check the packing too before handing it over for mailing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will clearly mark the top, check the packing, and send it with the meaning “do not turn upside down.” Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備後に箱を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll check the box once it is ready.
